blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Reconsider raising REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB to 1 GiB; the ticket's empirical investigation shows the ~633 MiB measurement is an all-heads checkout artifact fixable by adding `ref: main` to the initial actions/checkout (as siblings do), rather than legitimate growth.
evidence: .github/workflows/verify-identity.yml:50-53 initial `uses: actions/checkout@v7` sets `filter: blob:none` and `fetch-depth: 0` but no `ref:`

Ticket bc25-1351-dd0e-4909 comment: 'main-only blobless fetch ... size-pack: 22.84 MiB' vs 'all-heads blobless fetch ... size-pack: 633.02 MiB'; 'Proposed fix — narrow the checkout, do NOT raise the budget. Add `ref: main`'
search_files confirms siblings set `ref: main`: dependency-advisory-canary.yml:72, reconcile-bridge-canary.yml:97, gerrit-verify.yaml:221 — verify-identity.yml is the outlier
Ticket comment: 'Raising it again would silence the canary; narrowing the checkout removes the reason to.'
blocking.finding: The change raises the pack budget to 1 GiB to accommodate a measured pack size that the ticket's own investigation attributes to a checkout-shape bug (no `ref:` on actions/checkout fetches all heads including the tickets branch before measurement), rather than to legitimate growth; the recommended and lower-risk fix is to scope the initial checkout to `ref: main`.
scenarios: The pack budget was designed as a growth canary (ADR 0106); raising it to 1 GiB masks the all-heads checkout artifact and defers the real fix indefinitely.
70-day runway is computed against a growth rate that is itself an artifact of measuring all heads, not a main-only checkout.
blocking.suggested_fix: Add `ref: main` to the initial `actions/checkout@v7` step (matching reconcile-bridge-canary.yml/dependency-advisory-canary.yml/gerrit-verify.yaml) so the pack is measured against a main-only checkout, and keep the deliberate 102400 (or the prior 563200) budget instead of raising to 1048576.
